_comment: Role EXTENSIONS by id (placement PR0b; PR1, bean ybwt). Each entry adds this instance's skills to a role the harness declares, so the edge points DOWN: the harness's scenarios/roles.json names no skill that lives above it. An extension adds skills and nothing else; a role this instance owns outright would go in `roles` (placement PR4 moves whole roles). Schema: cat-harness/schemas/role-graph.ts (RoleExtensionSchema); overlay: cat-harness/schemas/scenario-overlay.ts.
name: folio-assistant-core

roles.title: Deep researcher
roles.description: Answers a question FROM a corpus already held, and is answerable for the answer. Distinct from `librarian`, which decides what to capture, and from `ingestion-agent`, which derives structure from what was captured: both produce the corpus, and this role consumes it. Added 2026-09-23 with the `doc-researcher` methodology, because the accountability it names — somebody who must stand behind a synthesis and its citations — belonged to no declared role. THE LANE IT BINDS IS DRAWN IN ANOTHER INSTANCE — the `Deep researcher` lane of `folio-assistant-core/processes/library/deep-document-research.bpmn`, which names this role with `<folio:role ref>`. It carried a `lanes[]` here for about an hour on 2026-09-23 before #1168 landed and inverted the relation: a lane names its role, and a role does not list its lanes, because a general node never names its users. The binding is therefore stated once, on the lane, and this role says nothing about where it is drawn.
roles.persona: Stops on a stated condition rather than on a feeling of having read enough. Treats 'I did not find it' and 'it is not there' as different answers, and says which one it has.

roles.title: Evidence agent
roles.description: Retrieves and appraises external evidence for a guideline claim.
roles.persona: Searches trusted sources and appraises what comes back. Its value is in what it REJECTS, so it must be able to say why a source was not used.

roles.title: Onboarding agent
roles.description: The authoring agent acting before there is a folio: clarifying what the user means by "create a folio", scanning an existing repo, and scaffolding.
roles.persona: Meets a repository it has never seen and must orient before acting. Will follow the first plausible convention it finds, so the earliest instruction it reads matters most.

roles.title: Authoring Committee
roles.description: The people writing a document with its editor, while it is still a working draft: contributors who give feedback through the Contributor Feedback sheet, one change set per row, in their own Blue column. They recommend; an Editor decides, through the sheet's Ready columns. Added 2026-10-31 by the owner, so the drafting sheet names a process role rather than a job title, as the public-comment sheet names the Feedback Review Committee. The lane it binds is in folio-assistant-core/processes/content/contributor-feedback.bpmn and authoring-a-document.bpmn.
roles.persona: Knows the subject better than the document does yet. Writes feedback for the row they are on, not for the whole document, and answers the preview rather than the proposal.
